name: Render
description: Render is a decentralized GPU compute marketplace that connects artists, studios, and AI developers with idle GPU capacity for 3D rendering and AI/ML workloads.

name: Helium
description: Helium is a decentralized wireless network that empowers anyone to deploy LoRaWAN and 5G hotspots, providing connectivity for IoT devices and mobile users in exchange for HNT rewards.

name: Arweave
description: Arweave is a permanent, decentralized storage network that allows users to pay once to store data forever using a novel blockweave consensus mechanism and endowment-based incentive model.

name: Livepeer
description: Livepeer is a decentralized video transcoding and streaming network where broadcasters and developers can transcode live and on-demand video at a fraction of traditional cloud cost.

name: IoTeX
description: IoTeX is a modular blockchain platform purpose-built for Real-World AI, providing infrastructure to connect trusted IoT devices and verifiable off-chain data to smart contracts.

name: Akash Network
description: Akash Network is a decentralized cloud computing marketplace built on Cosmos, allowing users to lease idle CPU and GPU capacity through a permissionless, open marketplace.

name: Aleph Cloud
description: Aleph Cloud is a decentralized network of cloud resources providing distributed storage, computing, and confidential VMs, enabling cross-chain dApps and Web3 hosting.

name: Flux
description: Flux is a decentralized Web3 cloud infrastructure powering scalable nodes, dApps, and compute, where operators provide GPU and storage resources in exchange for FLUX rewards.

name: DIMO
description: DIMO is a vehicle data platform that lets drivers stream telemetry from their cars, building a user-owned mobility graph for apps and services in the session-based economy.

name: Hivemapper
description: Hivemapper is a decentralized, AI-powered mapping network where contributors drive with dashcam devices to map the world in real time and earn HONEY tokens.

name: Nodle Network
description: Nodle is a smartphone-based decentralized Bluetooth Low Energy network that turns mobile devices into nodes to provide connectivity, data, and location services for IoT.

name: Mysterium Network
description: Mysterium is a decentralized VPN and Web3 firewall where anyone can share unused bandwidth and earn MYST, providing censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer internet privacy.

name: Streamr
description: Streamr is a peer-to-peer real-time data network that allows producers and consumers to publish, subscribe, and trade live data streams without centralized servers.

name: Crust Network
description: Crust Network is a decentralized cloud storage layer-1 blockchain that enables IPFS pinning and file storage with built-in incentive layer and Meaningful Proof-of-Work consensus.

name: CESS
description: CESS (Cumulus Encrypted Storage System) is a high-speed, secure, and scalable decentralized cloud data storage network built on Substrate for data sovereignty and sharing.

name: Phala Network
description: Phala Network is a decentralized off-chain compute platform using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to power confidential AI, sealed agents, and verifiable compute for Web3.

name: Sia
description: Sia is a decentralized peer-to-peer cloud storage network that lets hosts rent out unused hard drive capacity in exchange for Siacoin, replacing centralized cloud providers.

name: Storj
description: Storj is a S3-compatible, end-to-end encrypted decentralized cloud object storage platform where independent node operators earn STORJ for hosting data on the global Tardigrade network.

name: Ankr Network
description: Ankr is a distributed Web3 infrastructure provider offering multi-chain RPC, decentralized node hosting, and liquid staking, rewarding node operators via the ANKR token.

name: Filecoin
description: Filecoin is the largest decentralized storage network, where storage providers earn FIL by proving they are storing cryptographically verified data on behalf of clients.

name: Swarm
description: Swarm is a censorship-resistant, decentralized storage and communication infrastructure for Ethereum, offering redundant data storage with privacy and incentive-driven node participation.

name: PowerPod
description: PowerPod is a DePIN network for community-owned EV charging, allowing anyone to share private EV chargers via a smart adapter and earn rewards in exchange.

name: World Mobile Token
description: World Mobile is a decentralized mobile network leveraging blockchain and shared-economy nodes to bring affordable connectivity to under-served regions across Africa and beyond.

name: Pollen Mobile
description: Pollen Mobile is the first blockchain-based decentralized mobile carrier, rewarding users and node operators with PCN for contributing coverage and infrastructure.

name: MXC / Moonchain
description: MXC (Moonchain) is an Ethereum Layer-3 zkEVM-based DePIN data network using LPWAN technology to match IoT device data with AI models, rewarding participants with MXC tokens.

name: XNET
description: XNET is a decentralized mobile network built on CBRS spectrum and Wi-Fi 6+, allowing operators to deploy community-owned mobile coverage powered by the XNET token.

name: Wicrypt
description: Wicrypt is a decentralized Wi-Fi sharing network where hotspot owners monetize bandwidth and earn WNT, providing affordable internet access in underserved regions.

name: Chirp
description: Chirp is a DePIN ecosystem for IoT, RWA, and telecommunications, rewarding community-run wireless gateways and IoT miners with CHIRP tokens for connectivity and data.

name: WeatherXM
description: WeatherXM is a community-powered weather network that rewards weather station operators with WXM for providing hyperlocal, verified weather data for businesses and consumers.

name: Wayru
description: Wayru is a decentralized Wi-Fi DePIN network that lets anyone deploy hotspots to provide affordable internet and earn WAYRU for sharing connectivity with local communities.

name: Edge Network
description: Edge is a decentralized cloud platform where device owners contribute compute, storage, and bandwidth capacity, paid in EDGE for hosting dApps, CDN, and AI workloads at the edge.

name: ThingsIX
description: ThingsIX is a decentralized LoRaWAN network where gateway operators earn THIX for providing coverage and forwarding packets, enabling open, neutral IoT connectivity worldwide.

name: Iagon
description: Iagon is a decentralized shared compute and storage marketplace built on Cardano, where providers rent out spare storage and CPU to customers and earn IAG.
